title: Kenyan Baobab Smoothie
community: Urban Kenya — the superfood café drink
author: Chef Amina Hassan
desc: Kenyan Baobab Smoothie — tangy baobab powder blended with mango, banana, coconut milk, and honey. Africa's original superfood fruit in its most drinkable form — tart, fragrant, and extraordinarily nutritious.
longDesc: Baobab — the fruit of the ancient tree of Africa — is one of the most nutritious foods on the planet. Its tangy, slightly sweet powder blends beautifully with mango and banana, softened by coconut milk. In Kenya's growing health café scene, baobab smoothies have become the superfood drink of choice.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend on high speed until completely smooth.
chefTips: Frozen mango and banana give the best thick consistency.
Baobab powder varies in tartness — taste and adjust honey accordingly.
The coconut milk's fat carries the fat-soluble vitamins in the baobab.
cookingScience: Baobab contains both water-soluble (vitamin C) and fat-soluble (beta-carotene) nutrients. The coconut milk fat in this smoothie significantly enhances the absorption of the fat-soluble compounds compared to a water-based baobab drink.
sustainabilityTips: Baobab trees live for hundreds to thousands of years and are protected in Kenya.
Baobab fruit collection is a sustainable forest activity that incentivises tree conservation.
healthBenefits: Baobab has one of the highest vitamin C contents of any food.
Rich in calcium, magnesium, and potassium.
Very high in dietary fibre — prebiotic.
culturalNote: The baobab smoothie represents the meeting of Kenya's ancient food heritage and modern health café culture — an ancient African superfood fruit now served in glass cups at Nairobi's hippest cafés.
